title: The Conventional method of teaching
subtitle: 文化遗产 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）
meta: 主题语境：文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）　|　核心词汇：conventional　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 conventional 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the researcher wrote of ① a conventional method of teaching in the paper, and everybody in the lab said at once that it was ② more conventional than the one named there the year before. Three terms on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the researcher, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the conventional ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most conventional method of teaching anybody in the lab had ever seen, or so the paper for February 1958 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too conventional to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the student who had come to help; the conventional ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tube at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a conventional greeting in the village, and said that no student in his right mind would call it ⑥ as conventional as the greeting in the village they had once had in the old lab. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was conventional or not, and he said so.

By 1971 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the paper. What the line asked for was ⑦ something conventional, and nothing besides. The student from the next lab called the whole plan ⑧ quite conventional; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the paper kept the names of the conventional ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1974, at once, she wrote of another conventional method of teaching in the same paper, and the work, which took two terms, seemed ⑨ more conventional than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most conventional greeting in the village in the whole lab, she said in 1976, was the one she could never quite name; the conventional ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 传统（前置定语 a conventional method of teaching：1964 年研究员在研究报告里记下的那件传统的法子）
B. adj. 传统／常规（比较级 more conventional than：文中两处，一处比教书的法子，一处比预想）
C. adj. 传统／常规（最高级 the most conventional：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 传统（表语 too conventional to do：母亲觉得它太传统，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 常规（前置定语 a conventional greeting in the village：叔叔把整件事称作一桩常规的问候方式）
F. adj. 常规（同级比较 as conventional as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩村里的问候方式相比）
G. adj. 常规（后置定语 something conventional：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 常规（受程度副词修饰 quite conventional：那位学生的评价）

items.q: the most conventional method of teaching anybody
a conventional greeting in the village
The most conventional greeting in the village in

answers.why: conventional 意为“传统”，1964 年研究员在研究报告里记下的是“一件传统的法子”，此处作前置定语 a conventional method of teaching。
conventional 意为“传统”，此处用比较级 more conventional than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
conventional 意为“传统”，研究报告上 二月 那行字说它是实验室里最传统的一件，故用最高级 the most conventional method of teaching。
conventional 意为“传统”，母亲认为这件东西“太传统了，谁也用不上”，too conventional to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
conventional 意为“常规”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩常规的问候方式”，此处作前置定语 a conventional greeting in the village。
conventional 意为“常规”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩村里的问候方式一样常规”，同级比较用 as conventional as。
conventional 意为“常规”，研究报告上那半行字要的是“常规的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something conventional。
conventional 意为“常规”，邻实验室来的那位学生认为这套计划“相当常规”，quite 修饰原级 conventional。
conventional 意为“常规”，1974 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要常规”，故用比较级 more conventional than。
conventional 意为“常规”，母亲 1976 年说的是“整个实验室里最常规的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most conventional greeting in the village。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1964 年，研究员在研究报告里记下了一件传统的法子。（a conventional method of teaching）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更传统。（more conventional than …）
母亲觉得它太传统，谁也用不上。（too conventional to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩常规的问候方式。（a conventional greeting in the village）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩村里的问候方式一样常规。（as conventional as …）
到了 1971 年，研究报告上只剩半行字：要的是一件常规的东西。（something conventional）
answers: In 1964 the researcher wrote of a conventional method of teaching in the paper.
Everybody said it was more conventional than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too conventional to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a conventional greeting in the village.
He said nobody would call it as conventional as the greeting in the village they had once had.
By 1971 the paper asked for nothing but something conventional.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 conventional 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1964 the researcher wrote of a conventional method of teaching in the paper, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most conventional method of teaching in the lab, or so the paper says.
My mother thought it too conventional to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a conventional greeting in the village, and nobody argued with him.
The student from the next lab called the plan quite conventional, and everybody laughed.
The conventional ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
